beats.say: Thinking about becoming a landlord, or buying a property to rent out? There's a lot to know. We can help.
Pop into Your Move, and our lettings team will talk you through how it all works.
Landlords need things like safety certificates, a protected deposit, right to rent checks, and the right tenancy agreement.
The rules for landlords change often. Getting them wrong can be costly. That's where an experienced letting agent really helps.
Don't worry. We'll guide you, and with our management service, we can look after it all for you.

cast.say: That's a weight off my mind!

beats.say: Buying to let? We can also introduce you to Embrace Financial Services, who can advise on buy to let mortgages.
Your property may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage.
